description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams' in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies filtering and sorting options for candidate history search functionality, including candidate ID and action IDs.

classes.name: CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filtering criteria and sorting options when searching candidate history records within the recruitment module.

methods.name: getCandidateId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the candidate for whom the history search filter is applied.

methods.name: setCandidateId
methods.description: Sets the candidate ID for the search filter.

methods.name: getActionIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of action IDs to filter candidate history entries.

methods.name: setActionIds
methods.description: Sets the list of action IDs to filter candidate history entries.
